description: Locate exact text strings in a PDF and return each occurrence's page and coordinates (in PDF points). Use this for what pattern-matching can't catch — names, addresses, account references — by doing the entity recognition YOURSELF and passing the literal strings here; the engine resolves where they sit so you never guess geometry from a rendered page. Feed the returned regions straight to redact_pdf. Case-insensitive; a string the PDF splits across text operators may not match as one run. Each hit returns a masked preview, not the raw text. Nothing is uploaded.

pdfPath.description: absolute path to the PDF to search

name: locate_text
